_schema.purpose: Ground-truth model capabilities. Consumed by tools/llm_preflight.py AND by the LAN-side monster orchestrator. Override the server-reported context_length at load time using the values here.
_schema.editing: Every new local model added to spark1/spark2/LM Studio should get an entry here. Values from the model's HuggingFace config.json (max_position_embeddings) — not the server's advertised value. If the model documents an extended context via RoPE / YaRN scaling, record the scaled value here and note it in `notes` — this is the authoritative override the loader must honor.
consumers: LAN-side monster orchestrator (reads at model-load time; see issue #181)

qwen3-8b.notes: Qwen3-8B; HF config.json max_position_embeddings=40960 native, YaRN scaling to 131072. Monster must load with --context-length 131072 (YaRN) to satisfy Hermes Agent's 64K minimum. LM Studio's default advertise may be as small as 4096.

qwen3-30b-a3b.notes: Qwen3-30B-A3B MoE. HF config.json max_position_embeddings=40960 native, YaRN scaling to 131072. Same context ceiling as base Qwen3 family.

qwen2.5-coder-7b-instruct.notes: Qwen2.5 Coder; HF config.json max_position_embeddings=32768. No YaRN scaling; 32K is the hard ceiling.
